title: Checked hosts with invalid Host_IP values are silently dropped from runs — no error, no result, mismatched counts
existing_state: Invalid hosts are dropped silently at two layers. Form1.GetHostConnections skips any grid row whose Host_IP is blank or fails InputValidator.IsValidHostOrIp with a bare `continue` (Form1.cs:13313-13315). The service then skips again: ExecuteAsync continues past invalid hosts producing no ExecutionResult (SshExecutionService.cs:394-395 and 439-443, the latter logging only to debug), the script path does the same (:589-591), and ExecuteFolderAsync filters them out up front (hosts.Where(h => h.IsValid()), :634) even after the user explicitly checked those hosts in the run dialog. Status text is built from the already-filtered count ('Executing on N selected hosts...', Form1.cs:12771-12775; completion count at 12673-12677), so the user's only signal is arithmetic: 'Executing on 200 hosts...' followed by 'Completed execution on 198 hosts', with nothing identifying which two rows were skipped or why. The history entry contains no trace of those hosts.
recommendation: Surface skips instead of swallowing them: in GetHostConnections collect skipped row identifiers and show one upfront warning ('2 rows skipped — invalid Host_IP: row 37 "10.1.1.x ", row 88 ""'), and/or have the service synthesize a failed ExecutionResult with ErrorMessage 'Invalid host address' for each invalid HostConnection so the result count always matches the selection and the failure lands in output and history with a red X. The synthesized-failure option keeps run summaries truthful with minimal UI work.
user_benefit: A typo in one of 200 grid rows currently means that device silently never gets the change — discovered days later. With explicit skip reporting the user sees and fixes it immediately, and run summaries become trustworthy: every host you selected is accounted for.

evidence.note: GetHostConnections: silent continue on blank/invalid Host_IP
Service-level silent skips produce no ExecutionResult (debug-only log in one path)
Folder run filters invalid hosts even after explicit selection in the dialog
Status text reports post-filter counts; checked-vs-ran never reconciled
